nodes.recap: chapter header - aftermath of the Projector, Corolla treated, Kriss recounts the call to the group
nodes.text:
-------------------------------
|          CHAPTER 15          |
-------------------------------


Nobody speaks for a moment.##

Theo is looking at you with his brow very slightly furrowed,
which on Theo is the equivalent of a dropped jaw.#
Smiurl has crept out from behind Corolla
and is staring at you from roughly the height of your knee,
his skin running through small rapid pulses of uncertain orange.##

Efeliah says nothing.# She already knows.##

From the floor, a sound.# And then Corolla shifts, her hand moving first,
fingers pressing flat against the ground.##

$m"She will be all right,"$C# Math says quietly, his eyes not leaving you.#
$m"It is a superficial burn.# We have already contained the pain."$C##

You look at her, and believe him.##

Smiurl's skin flushes, slowly, into a relieved and luminous gold.##

Theo puts one hand briefly on Math's shoulder as he passes, crouching beside Corolla.#
No words.# Theo does not need words for this.##

They carry her two floors down, to the Municipal infirmary, and lay her on a cot
while Efeliah dresses the burn with salve and steady hands.# You sit close by,
and somewhere in the telling, the door, the pull, the white, the voice that called
you south, you find yourself walking them through all of it, the only way you know how.##

nodes.recap: flavor choice - trail off vs. push through, routes to distinct beats 28/29 before Riff arrives
nodes.text:
You are still trying to put words to something that never really had them,#
when your own sentence runs out from under you.##

What do you say, when you don't have the language for it?

choices.desc: Let the sentence trail off, unfinished.
Try, uselessly, to finish it anyway.

nodes.recap: branch: Kriss lets the sentence die, nobody minds
nodes.text:
You let the sentence die where it stands, and say nothing more.##

Nobody seems to mind.# Words were never going to be enough for it, anyway.

nodes.recap: branch: Kriss keeps groping for the word, gives up, nobody minds either way
nodes.text:
You keep going, groping for the word that isn't there,#
until even you can hear how little sense you're making, and you stop.##

Nobody seems to mind that either.

nodes.recap: Riff bursts in - victory account restored (machines fell silent, soldiers offered horses), Joe fleeing, squad sent

dialogues.precomment:
Running footsteps in the corridor outside, more than one pair, and then
the infirmary door bangs open.# Riff staggers in, followed by three of his fighters,
all of them bloodied and out of breath, grinning with the bewildered relief
of people who had stopped expecting to win.
dialogues.line: Hail to the saviors!
You're safe!
dialogues.comment: The relief in your own voice surprises you.

dialogues.line:
Of course, thanks to you! Your mad plan worked.# We were running,#
and right when we thought we were finished, the machines went dark behind us,#
all at once.# The sharper soldiers on our heels worked out what had happened#
and offered us their own horses to ride back into the city with.# It was glorious.
dialogues.comment: He is still catching his breath, half laughing.

dialogues.line: One moment—
—and Joe?
dialogues.comment: You finish the thought for him.

dialogues.line: He's fleeing.

We've already sent a squad of our best after him.# He'll be brought here soon,#
and justice will be done…
dialogues.comment:
As he says the last of it, something darkens in him.#
An old resentment surfaces on his face.

nodes.recap: flavor choice - wait vs. watch, routes to distinct beats 30/31 before Riff's mercy speech
nodes.text: Something old moves behind Riff's eyes, and for a moment none of you say anything.

choices.desc: Wait, and let him say what he needs to say.
Watch his face, and say nothing at all.

nodes.recap: branch: Kriss waits him out
nodes.text: You wait.# Whatever this is, it isn't yours to hurry.

nodes.recap: branch: Kriss watches his face instead of speaking
nodes.text:
You watch him instead of speaking, and something in his shoulders eases at the silence,#
as if he'd braced himself for questions.

nodes.recap: Math asks if Joe will be executed - Riff's mercy speech restored (tired of people dying, would leave him in the 'privileged' quarters)

dialogues.line: Will you have him executed?

I don't think so…# I am tired of seeing people die.#
If it were up to me, he would end his days in those 'privileged' quarters
he kept reserved for us, for years.
dialogues.comment: He says it flatly, without triumph.

nodes.recap: Corolla wakes, hugs, debt banter, sits up despite Efeliah, offers hand - 'Friends? For life.' [DECISION: reply]

dialogues.precomment: A small, disgruntled sound comes from the cot.
dialogues.line: Mhn…# Did they hit me?# Damn, I must be getting old…
dialogues.comment:
A general laugh breaks out.# You and Smiurl rush to hug her,
as much as the bandage across her back will allow.

dialogues.precomment: Efeliah watches, openly amused.
dialogues.line:
These two valiant heroes carried you here and there
the whole time you were unconscious.# You owe them your life as much as anyone's.
dialogues.comment: She says it with unmistakable irony.

dialogues.line:
Smiurl! Wonderful! Now I'm in your debt.# Just think how long
you'll be able to brag about it.
dialogues.comment:
She smiles at him.# His skin flares through half a dozen colors,
and he loses every word he was about to say.

dialogues.line: I still think it's the other way around.# I'm the one who owes you.
Don't even start.
dialogues.comment: She cuts you off.

dialogues.line: If it hadn't been me, it would have been Theo, or one of the others—
dialogues.comment: She silences you with a hand pressed flat over your mouth.

dialogues.line: But it was you.# That's what counts.
dialogues.comment:
She says it, smiling.# You feel your face go warm and look away,
but of course Efeliah and Math both notice.

dialogues.precomment: She sits up on the cot, despite Efeliah's efforts to stop her, and gets to her feet.
dialogues.line: You're not honestly going to try and stop me from moving, are you?
dialogues.comment: She holds her hand out to you.

dialogues.line: Friends?# For life.

replies.line: "Friends. For life." You repeat it, unsure what exactly you've just agreed to.
"...For life?" you ask, but you shake her hand anyway.
You say nothing, and just shake her hand.

dialogues.comment:
Not knowing what else to do, you take her hand and repeat the formula back to her.#
You don't know what kind of greeting, ritual, or common phrase it is, exactly.#
But it carries itself like something that matters.

nodes.recap: Math's announcement - 98% probability, pause, Efeliah's expression shifts, his request to stay, her shocked reply, Theo's principle, group nods

dialogues.precomment: A few moments of silence follow the handshake.# Math is the one who breaks it.
dialogues.line: I would like to make an announcement.

Efeliah and I know, with a good 98% probability, that Riff will be elected
mayor of Ayonn.
dialogues.comment:
Riff is dumbfounded.# Math pauses.## In the pause, Efeliah's expression changes,
as from night to day.

dialogues.line:
Given the great scientific and cultural patrimony that lies in this place,#
and the many machines built by the Master, I would like to ask the future mayor
to let me remain in this city as Municipal scholar, or something of the kind…#
if everyone present agrees, of course.
So THIS is what you were hiding from me!
dialogues.comment: She says it half amused, half devastated.

dialogues.line: We can't force him to stay.
dialogues.comment: You and Corolla nod.# Smiurl follows a beat behind them.

nodes.recap: the room turns to Efeliah - Kriss's stance is polled first [DECISION: choice, tracked for the atrium goodbye via node 9/10/11]
nodes.text:
Everyone turns to look at Efeliah.# Before she can answer, for a moment,
they look at you too.

choices.desc: Tell her you think Math should stay, if that's what he wants.
Say you're not sure Ayonn is safe enough yet to leave him behind.
Say nothing, and let it be her decision alone.

nodes.recap: poll branch: Kriss voices support for Math staying (visited-flag read later at node 24)
nodes.text:
$c"I think he should stay, if it's what he wants,"$C# you say.##

Math glances at you, something briefly grateful crossing his composed face.

nodes.recap: poll branch: Kriss voices doubt about Ayonn's safety (visited-flag read later at node 24)
nodes.text:
$c"Is Ayonn safe enough yet, for him to stay behind?"$C# you ask, unable to help yourself.##

Math considers the question seriously, and does not seem to hold it against you.

nodes.recap: poll branch: Kriss says nothing, leaves it to Efeliah (visited-flag read later at node 24)
nodes.text:
You say nothing.# This one is not yours to decide, and you know it.##

Efeliah catches your silence, and something in her shoulders eases, just slightly.

nodes.recap: Efeliah's uncertain consent; Riff agrees; Math prices it at 79%; 'Then we're agreed'

dialogues.precomment: After a few moments, in a voice not quite steady, she answers.
dialogues.line: Of course.# If you want to stay, if you feel you must, then you must stay…
dialogues.comment: She shrugs, resigned.

dialogues.precomment: Then it is Riff's turn.
dialogues.line: Fine by me, assuming I really do have the authority to grant it.
dialogues.comment: He says it, raising his shoulders.

dialogues.line:
Don't worry.# Your proposal will be received favorably by 79% of the population,#
municipal councillors included.
Then we're agreed.
dialogues.comment: He looks first at Math, then at all the others.

dialogues.line: Agreed.

nodes.recap: transition - later, gathered in Corolla's quarters before going down for dinner
nodes.text:
Later, you all gather in Corolla's quarters, before going down for dinner.##

$c"Oh, that reminds me,"$C# you say to Efeliah,# $c"we were talking about leaving.#
We think tomorrow at dawn is the best time."$C##

Efeliah sighs.##

$g"All right,"$C# she says.# $g"But now listen.# This is about your mind."$C

nodes.recap: Efeliah's revelation part 1 [DECISION: replies] - expanded functions during the Projector link, the overheard private conversation

dialogues.line: What's wrong?

It isn't that anything is wrong…# While I was connected to the Projector,#
Math and I could not help but examine it, study every point of it.# During the
connection to the machine, in fact, your brain's functions 'expanded', so to speak,
in every direction.# We didn't need to work around the blocks you've had since birth.#
Your mind laid itself open before us, like a painting at an exhibition.# A few days ago,
right after we left the Rock, I spoke with Math about something in your mind
that puzzled us both, and I proposed examining you.
Actually… I remember. You didn't notice, but I was right behind you. I was listening.

replies.line: "Actually… I remember. You didn't notice, but I was right behind you. I was listening."
"Funny you say that. I heard the whole thing. I was right there."

dialogues.precomment: At that, her eyes go wide.# After a few seconds she recovers, and says:
dialogues.line: You were listening?!# You have no idea what that means!

dialogues.precomment: They all look at her, uncomprehending.
dialogues.line: Is she crazy?
dialogues.comment:
He asks Corolla, pointing at Efeliah's exalted expression as she processes
the apparently shocking discovery that your hearing works perfectly well.#
Corolla silences him with an elbow.

dialogues.line: I wasn't speaking!# It was a telepathic exchange!

Wait a moment.# We've all heard these 'telepathic exchanges' back at the Rock.#
What's the problem?

Those were 'public' transmissions, so to speak, the way you'd speak to a group
of people.# What was passing between Math and me was a private conversation,#
one nobody should have been able to reach unless one of us allowed it.

dialogues.precomment: A silence.# Corolla is the one who breaks it.
dialogues.line: He's got a brain outside the normal.# There's no other explanation.
dialogues.comment: You look at her, then turn back to Efeliah.

nodes.recap: Efeliah's revelation part 2 [DECISION: replies] - two structures per hemisphere, the Oxengutter night explained, the 'vague impression' of change

dialogues.line:
Yes, that's it.# That's exactly what I came to tell you.# Examining your mind,#
we found certain structures, two for each hemisphere, that do not exist
in Noi-Hert brains.# They are so complex we could not work out how they function.#
But there is one significant fact.
Which is?
Do you remember that night, when we were attacked by the Oxengutter?
I remember.
Do you remember suddenly running for the sword, and killing the beast?
dialogues.comment: You nearly startle at the memory, so close and so sudden.# You hadn't thought of it since.

dialogues.line: Yes.

I fainted…# under the shock of an empathic overload.# Somehow you perceived
part of my sensations.# That alone would be remarkable, but the point is that
from that moment, until you collapsed at Smiurl's side, those areas I mentioned
went, so to speak, wild.# They received energy tens, perhaps a hundred times
above normal.# What happened after that, we don't know.# We found you beside
the Oxengutter's smashed skull.# Its mental activity had ceased, but those areas
were, so to speak, 'burning', from the sudden discharge of energy they'd received.#
That's why you had the fever, and the delirium, all that night.# It's understandable.

dialogues.precomment:
You stare at her, shaken, unable to quite believe it.# But you know she's
telling the truth.# You feel a hand on your shoulder.# It's Corolla.
dialogues.line: No lasting injuries…?
dialogues.comment: She asks, worried.

dialogues.line: No, his mind is strong, and it's back in shape now.# However…
However what?

After the session at the Projector, I have the vague impression
that some of your brain structures have changed.
And what does that mean?
I don't know.
dialogues.comment: She says it, letting her head drop.

nodes.recap: banquet setup - the hall, and the clothes (best characterization in the novel, let it breathe)
nodes.text:
Dinner comes.##

You change into the clothes provided by the household staff assigned to look after you,
and go down to the ground floor, at the rear of the Municipal building.##

The largest hall in Ayonn has been dressed in record time, to hold as many
ayonnesi as it can for an occasion this size, and perhaps this singular:
the day that will go down in Ayonn's history as $Wthe Liberation$C.##

You and the others walk in, and stop, looking around, plainly amazed.#
Impossibly long tables fill nearly the whole floor of the hall, set with hundreds
of dishes the city's cooks have spent the entire day preparing.# Enormous crystal
chandeliers hang from above, throwing colored light across the room and carving
strange shadows into the farthest, highest reaches of the vaulted ceiling.#
Along the sides, two colonnades descend from the roof, and they remind you,
more than anything, of the naves of a church.# There is no altar, though.#
Only a great, beautifully lit fountain.##

While you are still taking it in, a cluster of men in black, the most elegantly
dressed in the whole hall, approach and lead you to the seats of honor kept for you.##

Corolla lowers herself into her chair with care, favoring the burn.#
Even with a bandage clashing violently against a gown of black silk,
she loses none of her presence.# Her eyes look ready to throw sparks, amused, as always.##

Theo sits rigid and plainly uncomfortable without a weapon within reach,
squeezed into an enormous suit of dark gray.##

Smiurl draws laughter from half the room.# The only clothes small enough for him
were a child's: gray jacket and trousers, a red waistcoat, a white shirt.#
Nobody has told him so, of course, but he seems to be working it out for himself,
one amused glance at a time.##

Math and Efeliah look transformed.# Out of their tunics at last, he wears
an elegant black suit, evidently the latest word in ayonnese fashion, and she wears
a beautiful dress, long behind and short in front, that finally does justice
to her shape.# It is the same color as her eyes, which some expert hand has brought
out, along with her mouth.##

You, for your part, wear black trousers and a white shirt open at the collar.#
You have not, even for this, taken off the Oxengutter fangs.# You would never
do Theo an insult like that.# Somewhere underneath it all, it feels like
the right thing to do.##

The waiters' dance begins soon after: there is no other way to describe it.#
Dozens of young men and women stream through the hall, delivering full plates
and collecting empty ones, all in the same uniform, moving with a precision
that looks choreographed.##

nodes.recap: banquet table talk [DECISION: action] - councillors, Riff, Math's wine-loosened motive (heardMathMotive), Efeliah's Rock history + the drunk councillor's joke (heardRockHistory)
nodes.text:
Within a few hours you become something of a scholar of ayonnese cuisine:#
dozens of courses arrive at your table alone.# You have never sat down
to a banquet this rich, not even close to any wedding feast you ever attended,#
back home.# Dozens of wines accompany the courses, and it isn't long before
Smiurl wears an expression that says everything about his blood alcohol.##

There is time to talk, before whatever comes next.
nodes.alttext: The table talk continues around you, warm and unhurried.

objects.answer:
You find yourself telling the councillors, and Riff, seated among them,
your whole story again, how you felt the irresistible pull toward this city.#
$c"…and now we'll be leaving again,"$y you finish.# They wish you well, and one
of them remarks that having friends willing to follow you to the end of the world
is luck enough on its own.# $c"It is,"$y you agree, nodding at all of them in turn.#
$c"I wouldn't be anywhere, right now, if it weren't for every one of them."$y

One of the councillors asks whether it's true that Math will be joining them soon.#
Loosened by the wine, Math admits it plainly, in his own voice:# $m"I must confess it,"$y
he says,# $m"I am dying to study the Projector up close, so it can be put to a wiser use
than the one that tyrant made of it."$y

Another councillor asks whether your community, on that spire in the desert,
was founded by the same scholar who built the Projector.# Efeliah confirms it,#
nodding, loose strands of hair moving around her eyes as she talks.#
$g"He left us a code,"$y she says,# $g"a set of rules that are our principles
and our laws.# There is almost never a need to apply any penal sanction."$y##

A heavyset councillor nearby, who has so far preferred listening while working
through a second and then a third generous course of meat cooked, as you would
put it, $Wgod knows how$y, cackles into his cup:# "What a fine place!"$y

actions.answer: There's a great deal you could ask, at a table like this one.

condition.refusal: There's still more table talk worth hearing, before the night moves on.

nodes.recap: lights dim, music, stage appears at the fountain, names called to the stage
nodes.text:
You are still talking when the lights drop, all at once, and music spreads
through the hall, calling for silence.## Everyone turns toward the fountain.#
A stage seems to have appeared out of nowhere, ringing the water jets, now lit
more brightly than ever by lights you can't quite place.##

One of the councillors, who had slipped away from your table a moment before,
climbs onto it, and speaks:##

$y"We will now hold the award ceremony.# I invite to join me on stage
Mr. Riff of Ayonn, Kriss of Earth"$C# (a murmur runs through the hall)#
$y", Corolla and Theo of Øder, Smiurl of Desert City, Efeliah and Math
of Seer's Rock."$C##

You are bewildered.# It sounds like the drawing of some country club lottery,
not the ceremony you were half expecting, something closer to a medal for valor.#
Corolla and Efeliah nudge you both up onto your feet from behind.##

You make your way to the stage, where you find yourselves lifted, one at a time,
by some mysterious force rising from the floor.##

nodes.recap: awards ceremony [DECISION: action] - grants lightSphere, daggerReplica, laserRifle, amplifier; Theo's maul teasing, Math's amplifier + Efeliah's embrace
nodes.text:
The prizes are handed out in the order you appeared on stage.##

Riff receives a small gold sceptre, a single stone set into its head.#
You blink when you realize the stone is a diamond, and a large one.##

Then it is your turn.
nodes.alttext: The stage is still crowded with well-wishers, your friends' gifts still catching the light.

objects.answer:
They hand you a sphere, and you recognize it at once: one of the very lights
that terrified you in the canyon, the ones that killed the Chief.# You can activate
it now, and make it dance at will, whenever you want it.

Beside it, a dagger-sized replica of your own sword, faithful down to the smallest
detail, even the strange, uncertain half-stillness of the blade when it moves.#
It is set the whole length of its edge with red, blue and green stones.

actions.answer: You reach out, uncertain what's left to claim.

objects.answer:
They bring Corolla a laser rifle just like the one that burned her, and a
finely wrought gold necklace to go with it.

Four men wheel in Theo's prize on a metal cart: a platinum maul, identical
in size and heft to the one he already carries.# He raises it afterward
like a man showing off a bouquet of flowers.# $R"He'll probably have the nerve
to carry two now,"$y Corolla says.# Theo hears her, and turns.# $B"Oh, this one is
much heavier,"$y he says.# $B"I won't have any trouble carrying the other as well…"$y#
It's an astonishing number of words to come out of his mouth, and the satisfaction
on his face is just as plain.

Smiurl is handed a small coffer.# Inside, a scatter of gold earrings, enough
to multiply his collection several times over.# His skin runs through every
color he owns, twice.

Math is handed a smaller necklace, and beside it, a strange device neither
of them seems to recognize right away.# $g"What is it?"$y Efeliah asks, while Math
is already turning it over in his hands.# "Incredible!"$y they both exclaim,
at the exact same moment, in a single voice.# $c"What is it?"$y you ask.#
$g"Another of the Master's creations!"$y Efeliah says, delighted.# $m"A kind of
mental amplifier,"$y Math says.# $m"I believe I can use it to stay in contact
with you."$y# Efeliah embraces him.

For Efeliah, a diadem of diamonds and sapphires set in gold, and a necklace
to match Corolla's.

actions.answer: There's a great deal on this stage worth a closer look.

You turn to the applauding crowd and bow, then lift what you've been given
so everyone can see it properly.# After being interviewed, photographed, and hugged
nearly to death, you are finally allowed to retire to your rooms, where,
deep into the night, exhausted, you collapse.

nodes.recap: the long sleep - through the night and the following day; wake at sunset to Efeliah's tease and Theo's deadpan
nodes.text:
You sleep through the night.# You sleep through the whole next day, too.##

When you finally stir, you stretch your limbs and make your way down
to find something to eat.# You vaguely register that something is off
when you notice the lights are lit in the corridor outside.##

You make your way downstairs, through the halls, to the banquet room,
where you find Efeliah and Theo waiting for you.##

$g"Good morning, Kriss!"$C# she says when she sees you, laughing.# $g"Or rather,
good evening!"$C##

You stare at her, uncomprehending.# You look at Theo instead, impassive as ever.#
After about ten seconds, while Efeliah is still laughing to herself, he says:##

$B"It's sunset.# You've slept more than sixteen hours."$C##

You stand there a moment, blinking at him.# Then you go to a window to check,
and have to surrender to the plain fact of it.##

$g"Perhaps our efforts turned out to be a little more tiring than you'd estimated,"$C#
she says.

nodes.recap: councillor's provisions message; Corolla+Smiurl arrive, banter, Efeliah names his fear, Theo proposes dawn [DECISION: reply on Kriss's agreement]

dialogues.precomment: One of the councillors appears, drawing your attention.
dialogues.line:
It's a pleasure to see you again.# We've prepared everything you might need
for the journey.# You'll find the provisions there,
dialogues.comment: He gestures at one of the tables still standing from the night before.

dialogues.line: You may leave whenever you like.# Just let us know once you've decided.
dialogues.comment: He bows again, and disappears the way he came.

dialogues.precomment:
A few minutes later Corolla comes down, Smiurl in tow.# The moment he arrives,
the dwarf says:
dialogues.line: Must we really leave…?# I rather like it here…
dialogues.comment: He lights up faintly, remembering the culinary delights he's been allowed to enjoy.

dialogues.line: How's that?# Wasn't this the 'cursed city'?
dialogues.comment: You say, smiling.

dialogues.line: Well…
dialogues.comment: He looks at the ground, and shrugs.

dialogues.line: You can stay here if you want…# Math will be here with you anyway…
dialogues.comment: She says it partly to test him.

dialogues.precomment: Smiurl groans, torn apart by the conflict.# In the end he speaks up, sighing:
dialogues.line:
I'll come with you…# I can't play the coward and abandon my friends!#
My honor as a third-generation mutant is at stake!

dialogues.precomment: Efeliah studies him for a moment.
dialogues.line: That's not everything, is it?

dialogues.precomment: He looks at her, eyes wide, and after lowering them again, his voice trembling:
dialogues.line: Well… I suppose…

You don't trust him…# Or rather, you're afraid of me too, somewhere
at the back of your mind…
dialogues.comment: He looks at her, even more intimidated.# She points at his own reaction.

dialogues.line: See?
Ah! Damn it!
dialogues.comment: He stamps a foot on the ground, and crosses his arms.

dialogues.line: You're right, as always!
dialogues.comment: They laugh.

dialogues.precomment:
They put together a snack that turns out to be somewhere between breakfast
and a light dinner.# When they finish eating, Theo speaks.
dialogues.line: I propose we leave at dawn.# In the meantime we can pack, and rest, one last time.
Agreed.
Works for me…# You, Kriss?

replies.line: "Sure. At dawn. I've slept enough for one day."
"Dawn it is. I don't think I could sleep through anything else today."

dialogues.line: Then it's decided.
Does nobody ask MY opinion?!
dialogues.comment: Indignant.# They laugh again.

nodes.recap: atrium gathering before the council farewell
nodes.text:
Close to the third hour of the night, you gather in the great municipal atrium,
to say goodbye to the council.##

Ayonn is changed.##

Not the buildings, not the streets, which are the same gray and concrete
they always were, but the people are different, and you see it in every one you pass:
guards sitting against walls with their headbands removed, staring at their hands,#
civilians emerging from doorways, blinking, uncertain, as if waking
from a long sleep they did not choose and cannot quite place.#
Small knots of people finding each other, arms around shoulders,
the kind of stillness that comes just before someone starts to cry.

nodes.recap: travel clothes description; Riff's farewell; the reinstated 'expansive councillor friends' joke
nodes.text:
You've gone back to your travel clothes.# You are wearing again the ones you arrived
on Noi-Hert in, your sneakers most of all, far more comfortable than Theo's boots.#
The Municipal laundry took care of everyone's few belongings, of which, as it turns
out, there were not many.# Smiurl wears his same old, faded leather jacket.#
Theo wears only a pair of light trousers.# It is a striking thing to watch,
that mountain of muscle dragging behind him an enormous pack and two implausibly
large mauls.##

Efeliah has given up her tunic in favor of something more practical, and gladly
accepted some of Corolla's clothes: skin-tight black leather trousers, and a kind
of shirt torn off at the waist.# She looks perfectly at home in it.# You study
the two of them for a moment, thinking they look like a pair of beautiful warriors.##

dialogues.precomment:
You shake yourself out of the thought to bow to the councillors, who wish you
a good journey and all the rest of it, thanking you again half a dozen times more,
after assuring you of their undying hospitality toward you, and toward any friends
of yours who might one day pass this way.##

Then it is Riff's turn.
dialogues.line:
Friends.# I hope we meet again, one day.# I still cannot take in everything
you have done, for all of us.# It happened too fast.# Thank you.# Thank you again.
dialogues.comment: He embraces each of you in turn, moved.

dialogues.precomment: $c<<This one seems much more expansive than his councillor friends,>>$C# you think.
dialogues.line: You can say that again!
dialogues.comment:
Efeliah's answer arrives straight into your mind.# By now, you're used
to the contact.

nodes.recap: the goodbye remembers Kriss's earlier stance on Math staying [DECISION: gated choice, isNodeVisited on 9/10/11]
nodes.text: Then it is Math's turn.# He looks at you for a moment before he speaks.

choices.desc: Meet his eyes and hold them.# He remembers what you told him in the infirmary, and something in his glance thanks you for it.
Meet his eyes, unsure what you'll find there.# He remembers the doubt you raised, and doesn't seem to hold it against you.
Give him a small nod.# He remembers the silence you gave Efeliah, and seems to understand it.

nodes.recap: Math's farewell - good luck, amplifier confirmation, Projector reactivated note, 'take care of yourself'

dialogues.line:
I wish you good luck.# If the Master predicted your arrival, then your destiny
is sealed.# I am certain we will meet again.
We'll stay in contact with you through the amplifier, won't we?

Of course.# I'll make myself heard often.##

I don't want to hold you too long: too much sentiment now could cause hesitation,#
and that is the last thing you need.
dialogues.comment: He glances toward the Projector room above.# Then, as if remembering:

dialogues.line:
The Projector has been reactivated, but your minds will be ignored
by the machine.# Do not worry about it.
dialogues.comment:
He walks you to the door.# At the threshold he stops, and you understand
without being told that this is where he stays.

dialogues.precomment: You look at him: the scholar from Seer's Rock, the man who opened the psychic door.
dialogues.line: Take care of yourself, Math.
dialogues.comment:
He nods once.# Something in his expression closes into the particular stillness
of a man who finds it better not to speak.

nodes.recap: departure through the south gate - the shield seen from outside, 'the hemispheric glory of Ayonn'
nodes.text:
You set off along the main street just before dawn,
leaving the Municipal building behind, and Ayonn with it.#
You pass through the south gate while a gap is opened in the holographic shield,
and the guard on duty raises a hand as you step out,
and the moment your feet leave the city perimeter the shield closes
and takes its shape again behind you.##

You walk a few hundred meters and turn to look at it.#
From out here, without the dread the machine once projected, it is simply beautiful,
a hemisphere of shifting light sitting over the city like a second dawn.##

$c<<The hemispheric glory of Ayonn.>>$C#
$C$c<<I could not forget a place like this, even if I tried.>>$C##

$C"$cAnd come to think of it,"$C# you say aloud,
surprising yourself, $c"I could not forget any of the rest, either."$C##

$CThey look at you.# Then they turn back to the road.

nodes.recap: chapter end - party of five departs south
nodes.text:
Smiurl walks between Corolla and Theo, his skin cycling
through slow, warm colors: amber, rose, a satisfied cream.#
Corolla walks steadily, a little stiffly, the burn on her back a reminder
she is not going to dwell on.# Efeliah walks in silence,
her eyes already moving south.##

You walk.##

$c<<South.>>#$C

That is what you know.# That is what the machine told you,
or what something through the... machine? told you, and you are
not going to examine it too closely right now.##

Ahead: the road, and whatever comes next.##
